title: Perpetual Preferred Against Bitcoin Structural Credit Model
notes: If you use this repository, please cite the paper: Fairbanks (2026), Perpetual Preferred Equity Against Bitcoin: A Closed-Form Structural Credit Model. True North Research Report No. TNR-2026-05. https://tnorth.com/research/perpetual-preferred-equity-against-bitcoin-structural-credit-model/
description:
Reference implementation and test vectors for the paper "Perpetual Preferred Equity Against Bitcoin: A Closed-Form Structural Credit Model" (Fairbanks, 2026). Paper: https://tnorth.com/research/perpetual-preferred-equity-against-bitcoin-structural-credit-model/ (True North Research Report No. TNR-2026-05).

The model prices perpetual preferred equity issued against a Bitcoin reserve as the present value of its dividend payments until the reserve first reaches a coverage barrier. It produces a closed-form price and the Distance-to-Coverage-Breach (DCB), a vol-scaled log-distance from current coverage to the barrier.

This repository holds the code of the paper's Appendix D: three pure standard-library Python functions, the four test vectors of Appendix D.5, and a check that recomputes all 231 numeric cells of Tables 1 through 5 and Table C.1. It also holds the paper as published, in PDF and Markdown.
